name: Francolim-de-poupa
description: Chamado cadenciado e resposta breve da mesma espécie.
prompt: Authentic isolated dawn call of a Crested Francolin, Ortygornis sephaena, native to southern African bushveld. Characteristic rhythmic metallic cackling phrases, with a natural brief antiphonal response from another individual of the same species. Only this species. No domestic chickens, roosters, other birds, mammals, insects, music or voices.
